definitions.explanation: Pay calculated and received based on the number of hours worked.

examples.japanese: このバイトの{時給|じきゅう}は1,200{円|えん}だ。
examples.english: The hourly wage for this part-time job is 1,200 yen.

examples.japanese: {時給|じきゅう}が{高|たか}いバイトを{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a part-time job with high hourly pay.

examples.japanese: {深夜|しんや}は{時給|じきゅう}が25%アップする。
examples.english: The hourly wage increases 25% during late night hours.

notes:
{時給|じきゅう} is a compound: {時|じ} (time/hour) + {給|きゅう} (pay).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時給|じきゅう}で{働|はたら}く (to work on an hourly basis)
- {時給|じきゅう}が{上|あ}がる (hourly wage increases)
- {時給|じきゅう}1,000{円|えん} (1,000 yen per hour)
- {時給制|じきゅうせい} (hourly pay system)

JAPANESE MINIMUM WAGE:
Minimum wage in Japan varies by prefecture. It's set annually and increases gradually. {最低賃金|さいていちんぎん} refers to minimum wage.

NOTE:
{深夜|しんや}{手当|てあて} (late-night premium) of 25% applies to hours worked between 10 PM and 5 AM by Japanese labor law.
